text:
amanda: Quick sync in 20 for post-launch backlog grooming. Items from QA/support: UI polish bundle, a streaming perf regression on hosted API, a rare dedicated routing 502, and two non-urgent enhancements (rollout toggle + token telemetry). Need to decide hotpatch vs next sprint.

reza: Can you paste the QA bundle and rough effort? prioritize by customer impact and rollback risk.

amanda: Bundle summary: 6 defects — 4 UI (permission modal layout, empty-state copy, primary button focus ring, mobile overflow), 1 routing 502 (rare repro), 1 embedding mismatch (edge-case tokenization). Enhancements: rollout toggle for canary control, improved token breakdown telemetry. Estimates: UI fixes ~1 dev-day (low-risk), routing/perf = urgent (unknown surface), enhancements = next sprint.

ben: If regression affects streaming path it could be high impact. I'll triage traces immediately. Any repro in staging?

lia: UX note: UI bugs live in new onboarding; visible but not data-loss. I can scope quick fixes to be purely CSS/strings to keep risk low.

reza: Proposed plan: 1) Hotpatch routing + streaming perf if triage shows config/regression (owner: ben). 2) Canary for the 4 UI fixes if purely presentational (owner: lia + FE). 3) Schedule toggles & telemetry next sprint. Objections?

lia: +1. I'll add an a11y check for the modal. Can do design review in ~4 hours.

ben: Starting on traces 1: hypothesis: KV cache invalidation or kernel selection change for longer seqs. If config we can hotpatch in hours; kernel-level change needs gated rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for branch "ux-fixes-canary" at 15:30 UTC 1 awaiting approvals.

amanda: Plan recap: (A) hotpatch routing/perf (ben) 1 go/no-go after triage; (B) UI canary for 4 low-risk fixes (lia + FE) 1 run canary and smoke; (C) toggle + telemetry in next sprint. I'll update tickets with rollback steps.

reza: I'll update roadmap board and label tickets: hotpatch/ship, next-sprint, needs-design.

ben: Ops note: ensure token-level logs redacted during canary. For gated deploy: `./deploy --canary --feature-gate=ux-fixes-canary`.

lia: I'll assemble screenshot diffs and a short QA checklist. @marta can you run the visual regression after canary?

marta: I can reproduce the routing 502 locally with the repro steps; will run full regression post-canary and report results.

amanda: Scheduling a 15-min stand in 10 to confirm owners + rollback. Agenda: risk, timeline, verification. I'll post updated ticket numbers after the call. Thanks everyone!
